scope: Name and locally enforce the first P0 candidate metadata boundary; no server or distribution rollout.
independence: Each repository owns its policy, version declarations, checker and tests. No sibling checkout dependency.

macDMGChecks: Inspect original immutable packaged app despite external app changes
Restore project/scheme after a forced build failure
Reject changed image bytes, inputs and modes
Reject valid signed disposable payload below minimum build inside actual mounted DMG
Reject wrong app identity inside actual mounted DMG

enforcement.source: All four app/widget Debug/Release declarations and Mac generator checked
enforcement.exportedApp: Production bundle identity, minimum metadata, matching widget required by explicit local checker
enforcement.macPublication: Project preflight plus minimum packaged app build in existing immutable-DMG verification; source fingerprint includes owned Config policy and checker
enforcement.iosPublication: Operator must run project and actual exported-app checks before distribution; no upload pipeline invoked

rolloutLimits: Older active writers must be upgraded or retired, retaining unsent data; if inventory cannot be established, workspace remains outside P0 rollout
Server still permits legacy direct task updates; new-client guarded RPC does not prevent old writers overwriting later
Minimum versions reserve unreleased candidates, not already shipped products
Mac/phone native label collision, installed widget/system privacy, spoken accessibility, external provider and runtime gates remain
Signing is user-deferred; no APNs authority, schema, RLS, account or production data changed
No release build, archive, notarization, publication or upload performed; Xcode showBuildSettings is metadata evidence only

preservation.pendingMacWidgetFixture: Exact fingerprint unchanged; pending host is the only live Taskfold process
preservation.nativeMacBoundary: Two relevant native app reads returned cgWindowNotFound; no replacement or repeat of failing Mac XCTest attempt
preservation.disposableDMGs: TemporaryDirectory fixture apps/DMGs removed by test teardown; no fixture executable launched
